data.message: Fisher01–25: individual opt-in, not an all-or-nothing deal: I commit to 18 tons. Each switch from 10 to 18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, remaining=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). This risks future income; recovery to500 isn't guaranteed. Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation. Each of you: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Fisher02/Fisher20, please help recruit.
